title: Input manifest
description: Every file a build reads, named once with where it comes from and its MD5. A build checks each file against its MD5 before it reads it, whoever staged it.

file.description: path relative to the inputs folder

role.description: reference_output: read only to check parity

redistribution.description: checksum_only: the source's terms forbid redistribution; the file is never copied into a repository, only its MD5 is recorded, and a build reads it from its root when it is there (the questions that need it are left out, and said so, when it is not)

columns.description: how to read the file when no built-in reader knows it: one column mapping, or a list of them (several tables side by side in one file, each partner of a pair say)

record.description: the source's own page for a protein, with {acc} for its accession (linked from the protein pages)

mapping.description: how to read the file when no built-in reader knows it: the columns that hold each field. Intervals: accession, start, end (1-based, inclusive), and optionally label, ref, subtype, class; per-residue values: accession, position, value. include/exclude keep rows; kind, if given, is the kind of units the file holds. Besides start and end, a unit's place may be a position (or a list of them, with separator), ranges (a list of start-end), residues (a list such as R169,A203) or marked_in (a sequence whose lower-case letters mark residues); residue, sequence (with relocate), gene, canonical, start_offset, max_per_row and unique_within check and place them on the site's sequences (CONTRACTS.md).

relocate.description: with sequence: an interval whose sequence the snapshot does not read at its place is moved to the only place it does (else dropped)

canonical.description: an isoform accession (P12345-2) is read as its entry

start_offset.description: added to every start (1 for a table counting from 0)

max_per_row.description: rows naming more residues than this are dropped

unique_within.description: rows grouped by these columns; a group is kept only if it places exactly one residue

sequence_start.description: with sequence: the column of the start where the sequence is read, when not at the unit (a peptide inside the region the row gives)

max_length.description: units longer than this are dropped

same_as.description: another column: the row holds when both cells are equal

on_snapshot.description: the cell, an accession, is (true) or is not (false) a protein of the site's sequences

matches.description: a regular expression the whole cell matches
